verdict.rationale: No evidence of any bulk operation capability (e.g., bulk employee updates, bulk payroll changes, batch import/export) — the docs only describe single-item workflows like recording one payment, setting up one policy, or mapping one pay type at a time. There's a mention of an MCP endpoint (justworks-docs-26) but no detail on it supporting bulk/batch actions across many items, and API probes for OpenAPI/llms.txt return 404s, suggesting no documented programmatic bulk interface.
